The '''''Rook''''' was a [[720 light freighter/Legends|720 light freighter]] owned by the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. [[Ghitsa Dogder]] was taken there to be interrogated to learn of [[Durga Besadii Tai]]'s dealings with the [[Orko SkyMine Asteroid Processing Corporation|Orko Consortium]]. After Ghitsa's rescue by [[Fenig Nabon]] and [[Kyp Durron]], who cut their way out of the ship, the ''Rook'' took off and was destroyed after [[Hull/Legends|hull]] depressurization.
